policies_public_least_privilege.name: policies_public_least_privilege
policies_public_least_privilege.value: "lumibase_policies"."key" is distinct from 'public' or ("lumibase_policies"."admin_access" = false and "lumibase_policies"."app_access" = false and "lumibase_policies"."enforce_tfa" = false)

roles_public_least_privilege.name: roles_public_least_privilege
roles_public_least_privilege.value: "lumibase_roles"."system_key" is distinct from 'public' or ("lumibase_roles"."admin_access" = false and "lumibase_roles"."app_access" = false)

llm_attempts_source_check.name: llm_attempts_source_check
llm_attempts_source_check.value:
("lumibase_llm_attempts"."source" = 'site' AND "lumibase_llm_attempts"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lumibase_llm_attempts"."instance_ref" IS NULL)
       OR ("lumibase_llm_attempts"."source" = 'instance' AND "lumibase_llm_attempts"."provider_id" IS NULL AND "lumibase_llm_attempts"."instance_ref" IS NOT NULL)

llm_calls_terminal_check.name: llm_calls_terminal_check
llm_calls_terminal_check.value:
("lumibase_llm_calls"."status" = 'open' AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."terminal_reason" IS NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."winner_attempt_id" IS NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."result" IS NULL)
       OR ("lumibase_llm_calls"."status" = 'completed' AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."terminal_reason" IS NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."winner_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."result" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("lumibase_llm_calls"."status" = 'failed' AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."winner_attempt_id" IS NULL AND "lumibase_llm_calls"."result" IS NULL)

llm_providers_pricing_check.name: llm_providers_pricing_check
llm_providers_pricing_check.value:
("lumibase_llm_providers"."pricing_kind" = 'per_1m_tokens' AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."input_price_micros" IS NOT NULL AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."output_price_micros" IS NOT NULL
            AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."input_price_micros" >= 0 AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."output_price_micros" >= 0)
       OR ("lumibase_llm_providers"."pricing_kind" = 'per_request' AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."request_price_micros" IS NOT NULL AND "lumibase_llm_providers"."request_price_micros" >= 0)
